title: TITAN PACK — 2D Packing Puzzle
metaDesc: Rotate and place rectangular blocks to fill the board with zero gaps.
subtitle: Rotate and place all blocks to fill the board with no gaps
bannerIdle: Select a block and tap the board to place
btnSolveTitle: Places 1 unplaced block in its solution position
tip: TIP: [R] Rotate / [Z] Undo / Tap selected block to rotate
winBody1: All blocks fitted onto the board with zero gaps!
winBody2: Every cell on the board is covered. Ready for the next puzzle!
winBody2Perfect: An interlocking layout with no continuous split line across the board!
theoryBody1: 2D Strip/Bin Packing is a classic NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem where rectangular blocks must be packed onto a board with no overlaps or gaps.
theoryBody2: WaSHI linearizes coordinate positioning, rotation disjunctions, and pairwise non-overlap conditions via Big-M Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), solved to optimality with HiGHS.
